name: @ua-map/llm-providers
description: Multi-provider LLM abstraction for Aegis Lens — Anthropic Claude (primary), OpenAI (failover + specialty), open-weights (HuggingFace / self-hosted vLLM, sovereignty fallback). Unified LlmProvider interface: complete / stream / tool-calling, provider-agnostic streaming, cross-provider tool spec, prompt caching, per-provider×feature cost tracking, per-tenant BYOK, cross-provider eval parity, fail-closed PII pre-send redaction, and provider-outage failover routing. Never single-provider (concentration + ToS-volatility risk).
